access.name: Login shows an error and rejects valid details
access.definition: Entering the correct password, email or Facebook login produces an error message or is refused; not a phone-number code problem and not a launch failure.

access.name: Phone number login code never arrives
access.definition: A phone-number login sends no verification code, or says to try a different number, so the user cannot sign in by phone; not a password or email login error.

access.name: Logged out and cannot sign back in
access.definition: The app signs the user out by itself, often repeatedly, and then the user cannot log back in; not a signup or account-missing problem.

access.name: App stalls on logo and never opens
access.definition: After tapping the app, it stays on the Spotify logo or splash screen or hangs with 'not responding' and never reaches the home screen; not an offline message.

access.name: Says offline while internet works
access.definition: The app shows a no-internet or 'You're offline' message even though the device is connected and other apps work; not a login rejection.

access.name: Cannot create account or finish signup
access.definition: A new user cannot create an account, or cannot complete signup or trial activation, because the sign-up step fails; not an existing account that cannot log in.

access.name: Account deleted, blocked or forced to reset
access.definition: The user's account disappears, is linked to a different account, or is locked and forces a password change for suspicious activity; not an error shown during a normal login attempt.

usability.name: Familiar option or feature is gone
usability.definition: A control, sort, button or feature the user used before no longer appears in the app; not a feature that exists but is locked behind a paid plan.

usability.name: Screens hard to navigate or scan
usability.definition: Users cannot find recently played items, things moved to new places, or cannot read a redesigned screen quickly; not a crash or a button that does nothing.

usability.name: Playlists or songs will not open
usability.definition: Tapping a playlist, album, liked-songs view or song does nothing or fails to open its contents; not a search that returns no results.

usability.name: Cannot edit or save library items
usability.definition: Users cannot add podcasts, change a playlist cover, sort or filter their library correctly, or see changes reflected; not playback itself.

usability.name: Chosen song or position not played
usability.definition: The app plays a different track than the one selected, forces shuffle or order, or ignores rewind and seek requests; not a song that stops by itself.

usability.name: Ads play too often
usability.definition: Users report ads that repeat too frequently or interrupt listening; not complaints about the price of a paid plan.

playback.name: Music pauses or stops on its own
playback.definition: Playback halts by itself partway through a track or after seconds, with the app still open; not the app closing, which is a crash.

playback.name: App crashes or freezes
playback.definition: The app closes unexpectedly or hangs and stops responding while in use; not music that stops while the app keeps running.

playback.name: Chosen music refuses to start playing
playback.definition: Pressing play on a song or playlist does nothing or shows it playing while silent, until the user restarts or switches tracks; not a track that starts and then stops.

playback.name: Wrong track skips or repeats
playback.definition: Playback jumps to another song, restarts the current song, or repeats a track without repeat being on; not a pause or stop.

playback.name: Audio glitches, distortion or quality drops
playback.definition: Sound stutters, fluctuates, drops out briefly or sounds worse than before while the track keeps playing; not a full stop.

playback.name: Playback controls stop responding
playback.definition: Pause, skip, back or stop buttons in the app fail to act, or audio keeps playing without any working controls.

playback.name: Playback starts without being requested
playback.definition: Music or a podcast begins or resumes by itself with no user action, including when the app is not open; not a stop or pause.

playback.name: Songs or playlists fail to load
playback.definition: Playlists, liked songs or tracks never appear or load in the app, or loading hangs indefinitely; not a track that loads and then plays badly.

playback.name: Shows no internet when connected
playback.definition: The app displays a no-connection or offline message while the phone has working internet or mobile data.

billing/support.name: Basic features locked behind premium
billing/support.definition: Free users cannot use features they expect for free, such as skipping, lyrics, choosing songs, queue, seeking or downloads; not the price of premium and not a paying member being locked out.

billing/support.name: Paying member cannot use premium features
billing/support.definition: A user with an active premium subscription finds premium features blocked or unavailable, including after account or login problems; not a free user facing a paywall.

billing/support.name: Ads play for premium subscribers
billing/support.definition: Premium members hear or see ads or sponsored content they paid to remove; not free users seeing ads.

billing/support.name: Cannot buy or upgrade premium
billing/support.definition: Attempts to start or upgrade premium fail, freeze, redirect to the wrong screen or are refused as ineligible; not charges taken after a purchase.

billing/support.name: Charged unexpectedly or after cancelling
billing/support.definition: The user is billed twice, billed after cancelling, or charged or renewed without prior notice; not a purchase that fails to complete.

billing/support.name: Premium costs too much
billing/support.definition: The user says the premium subscription price is too high or not worth it, without citing a locked feature or a billing error.

billing/support.name: Support gives no reply or scripted advice
billing/support.definition: A support request gets no response, or the reply is generic, repeats useless troubleshooting steps or is unhelpful; not a support page or form that fails to work.
